name: Ramona Valley
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: An AVA around the town of Ramona in central San Diego County, entirely within the South Coast AVA. A ring of hills and mountains encircles it, setting it above the lower coastal valleys to its south, west and north.
